test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

The customer asked the shopkeeper how much she had to pay for the little glass table.

options.text: The customer said to the shopkeeper, “How much have I to pay for the little glass table?”
The customer said to the shopkeeper, “How much I am to pay for the little glass table?”
The customer said to the shopkeeper, “How much she had to pay for the little glass table?”
The customer said to the shopkeeper, “How much had I to pay for the little glass table?”

solution:
The correct answer is- 'The customer said to the shopkeeper, “How much have I to pay for the little glass table?”'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change the sentence to a direct speech we need to follow the following steps:

 
 
• In the given sentence, the verb (*had*) in the reported speech will change to 'have'. 
 
• Change the *assertive sentence *to an *interrogative sentence*. And remove the **infinitive words **(*asked*).
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• Indirect: She asked wheth
